open_gaps.summary: UEM machine, generator, and framework modules are not yet fully expressed as seed package bodies; currently handwritten under unified/.
Python/C UEM hosts still use imperative control flow (required for physical boundary execution until seed can emit hosts).
unified/machine/primitives.py defines class _ExprFail — forbidden OOP; must become plain-data fault path.
Application declarations live as .py modules with Python syntax; must be pure JSON under seed/declarations/.
Python and C interpreters are parallel implementations; Standard Ten requires one UEM with hosts as boundaries only. Semantic parity is proven (L11) but structure is dual-impl.
Tests and documentation are handwritten, not generated from seed/declaration.
Clean-room regeneration cannot yet emit the full repository from seed alone.
